highlights: A gateway restart no longer destroys the Agent Chat turn you were watching; live runs reattach instead of being abandoned.
Share links can enforce an owner-selected request throttle, and embeddable origins are now one owner-controlled allowlist.
Project deployments declare whether Portal or an external service owns the runtime, with honest Refresh, Start, and Restart.
Stuck provider sign-ins can be reset from the wizard, and a refused login reports the real reason instead of an exit code.
Portal branding is consistent across auth, icons, metadata, and email, and all frontend dependency advisories are cleared.
